# Overview

We here use the averaged WGBS data from WGBS atlas and the methylation array data from Kristin Fritsches ALI stomach samples to compare array and WGBS in stomach antrum. 


```{r}
ed <- read.table( "../../../../Data/Raw/ClonalCultures/DNA_Methylation/IDAT_with_healthy_stomach/sample_sheet_with_healthy_stomach.csv", sep=",", header=T)
ed$sample_label <- ifelse(substr(ed$Sample_ID,1,2)=="DE", paste0(ed$Sample_Group, "_", ed$PatientID, "_", ed$CloneID), ed$Sample_ID)


load(file.path(data_storage_folder,"myNorm_IM_nonIM_and_healthy_stomach_anno_sorted.RData") )
antrum_array <- myNorm_anno_sorted[, c("23-AU","24-AU","26-AU", "23-AD","24-AD", "26-AD")]
antrum_avg <- rowMeans(antrum_array)

corpus_avg <- myNorm_anno_sorted[, c("23-CU","24-CU","26-CU", "23-CD","24-CD", "26-CD")] |> rowMeans()

fundus_array <- myNorm_anno_sorted[, c("23-FU","24-FU","26-FU", "23-FD","24-FD", "26-FD")]
fundus_avg <- rowMeans(fundus_array)

im_samples <- subset(ed, ed$Sample_Group=="IM")$Sample_ID
nonim_samples <- subset(ed, ed$Sample_Group=="non-IM")$Sample_ID


im_avg <- myNorm_anno_sorted[, im_samples] |> rowMeans()
nonim_avg <- myNorm_anno_sorted[, nonim_samples] |> rowMeans()
 


```

```{r}
wgbs <- readRDS(file=file.path("../../../../Data/Processed/WGBS", "WGS_Cpg_Meth_avg_beta_11organs.rds"))
wgbs <- wgbs[!is.na(wgbs$ilmn_id), ]
```


```{r}
comb_data <- wgbs
comb_data$antrum_array <- antrum_avg[wgbs$ilmn_id]
comb_data$corpus_array <- corpus_avg[wgbs$ilmn_id]
comb_data$fundus_array <- fundus_avg[wgbs$ilmn_id]
comb_data$im_array <- im_avg[wgbs$ilmn_id]
comb_data$nonim_array <- nonim_avg[wgbs$ilmn_id]
comb_data <- comb_data[!is.na(comb_data$antrum_array), ]
rownames(comb_data) <- comb_data$ilmn_id
```

```{r}
#sel_samples <- c("Gastric.antrum","Gastric.body","Gastric.fundus","Small.int", "Colon.Left", "Colon.Right","antrum_array", "corpus_array","fundus_array", "nonim_array", "im_array")
sel_samples = colnames(comb_data)
sel_samples = sel_samples[!sel_samples %in% c("ilmn_id","chr","pos")]
```

```{r}
## modify mdsPlot function to not show the legend

my_mdsPlot = function (dat, numPositions = 1000, sampNames = NULL, sampGroups = NULL, 
          xlim, ylim, pch = 1, pal = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"), legendPos = "bottomleft", 
          legendNCol, main = NULL) 
{
  if (is(dat, "matrix")) {
    b <- dat
    if (is.null(main)) 
      main <- sprintf("MDS\n%d most variable positions", 
                      numPositions)
  }
  else {
    stop("dat must be an 'MethylSet' or 'matrix'.")
  }
  o <- order(-matrixStats::rowVars(b))[1:numPositions]
  d <- dist(t(b[o, ]))
  fit <- cmdscale(d)
  if (missing(xlim)) 
    xlim <- range(fit[, 1]) * 1.2
  if (missing(ylim)) 
    ylim <- range(fit[, 2]) * 1.2
  if (is.null(sampGroups)) 
    sampGroups <- rep(1, numPositions)
  sampGroups <- as.factor(sampGroups)
  col <- pal[sampGroups]
  if (is.null(sampNames)) {
    plot(fit[, 1], fit[, 2], col = col, pch = pch, xlim = xlim, 
         ylim = ylim, xlab = "First dimension", ylab = "Second dimension", main = main, cex.axis = 0.8, cex.lab = 0.8)
  }
  else {
    plot(0, 0, type = "n", xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, xlab = "First dimension", 
         ylab = "Second dimension", main = main, cex.axis = 0.8, cex.lab = 0.8)
    text(fit[, 1], fit[, 2], sampNames, col = col)
  }
  legend(legendPos, legend = levels(sampGroups), fill=pal[1:length(unique(sampGroups))])
}

```


```{r MDS plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
tmp <- as.matrix(all_samples[, 2:ncol(all_samples)])
sample_groups = c("Colon.Left"="Intestine WGBS",
                  "Colon.Right"="Intestine WGBS",
                  "Small.int"="Intestine WGBS",
                  "Gastric.antrum"="Antrum",
                  "Gastric.body"="Corpus",
                  "Gastric.fundus"="Fundus",
                  "antrum_array"="Antrum",
                  "corpus_array"="Corpus",
                  "fundus_array" = "Fundus",
                  "im_array" = "IM",
                  "nonim_array" = "Non-IM")


my_mdsPlot(tmp, numPositions = 1000, sampGroups = sample_groups[colnames(tmp)], sampNames = colnames(tmp), legendPos = "bottomright")
my_mdsPlot(tmp, numPositions = 5000, sampGroups = sample_groups[colnames(tmp)], sampNames = colnames(tmp), legendPos = "bottomright")
my_mdsPlot(tmp, numPositions = 10000, sampGroups = sample_groups[colnames(tmp)], sampNames = colnames(tmp), legendPos = "bottomright")
```
